title: Almost sparse operators and Bergman projectors on trees
summary: We develop a sparse domination framework adapted to nested families in general measure spaces, possibly including point masses. We show that the Carleson condition is equivalent to a slight generalization of the usual sparse condition, and use this characterization to obtain one- and two-weight estimates for the associated averaging operators, together with converse testing conditions. We apply our general results to integral operators on locally finite trees. Trees come naturally equipped with two nested geometries: sectors and pruned sectors.
